how: Opened the public Gemini share page and selected the longest response (a <message-content> element: KaTeX math and tables) with a DOM range, then ran document.execCommand("copy"). The shared (signed-out) view has no per-response copy button, only "Copy prompt" on user turns, so there is no copy-button capture.
notes: Gemini share page, selection of the longest <message-content>. No per-response copy button exists on the signed-out share page (only 'Copy prompt' on user turns). Math is <span class="math-inline" data-math="CH_4 \\rightarrow C + 2H_2"> (TeX in the data-math attribute) wrapping KaTeX DOM whose <math> has no TeX annotation; Plain text linearises the math (one token per line, followed by the KaTeX sub/superscript text again). 2 tables.
